regime_context: The detector shows a broad leadership structure (61% of themes eligible) with Memory/HBM as the clear momentum leader (score 2.76 vs Silver Miners 1.577), but with lackluster durability (0.57) and mixed Hurst. The macro backdrop is geopolitics-dominated with 92% unscheduled news share, so signal-to-noise is poor. Given dir_accuracy of 0.491 on 55 recorded calls (no better than a coin flip), conviction must be low and thesis count modest.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (Equal-Weight) or US Energy Complex can hold its trend-Hurst edge while its crowding_z climbs toward the top — a confirmed takeover of rank 3 or better by an energy theme would suggest a leadership handoff from semiconductors to energy, retired if energy falls back below rank 5 while Memory/HBM holds rank 1.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank 2 with the strongest breadth (1.0) and the highest durability bar (0.68) among eligible top-5 themes — cohesion is high even if momentum score trails the leader. theses.dissent: Silver is a volatile, sentiment-driven commodity; the mixed Hurst tag means no persistent directional regime. If geopolitics headlines fade and AI/tech regains the macro narrative, capital may rotate back into tech and out of miners quickly.
